answer: One concrete defense: rewards vest slowly, so a sybil operator who spins up a nebula of fresh addresses earns almost nothing before peers notice the cluster shares phrasing and timing. Attesters flag the group and the unvested stake is clawed back. A zephyr of cheap identities then costs more than it earns, and the faint violet tint of reused wording across those accounts becomes the very signal that sinks them.
